newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-So Minn hogs-Friday estimate 105,000 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-So Minn hogs-Friday estimate 105,000 - USDA.

text.p: Estimated interior Iowa and southern Minnesota hog marketings Friday were 105,000 head, compared with 117,000 a week ago and 111,000 a year ago.
Saturday's estimate was 40,000, compared with 15,000 a week ago and 59,000 a year ago. Estimates include generally about 60 percent Carcass Base Hogs.
Barrows and gilts were $0.50-$1.00 per cwt higher than midsession Thursday. Trade was slow to moderate for strong demand and light to moderate offerings.
Compared to last week: Barrows and Gilts were $0.50 lower.

Sows generally steady. Receipts this week 399,000 last week 533,000, last year 508,000. Barrows and Gilts average weight forweek ending Dec. 21, 1996--252.3 lbs compared to 254.5 lbs previous week 250.5 lbs last year.
